import os,sys,json,pathlib,subprocess,time,hashlib,urllib.parse,datetime
ROOT=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
OUT=ROOT/'.local/step07-review';EVID=OUT/'evidence';EVID.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
ENV=os.environ.copy()
ENV['PATH']='/Users/dingshinn/.nvm/versions/node/v22.21.1/bin:/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@14/bin:'+ENV['PATH']
for line in (ROOT/'.env').read_text().splitlines():
 if line and not line.startswith('#'):
  k,v=line.split('=',1);ENV[k]=v
ENV.update(TILESET_PG_BIN='/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@14/bin',STEP07_TEST_API_PORT='4395',INTEGRATION_API_PORT='4395')
URL=urllib.parse.urlsplit(ENV['DATABASE_URL']);assert URL.hostname=='127.0.0.1' and URL.port==55495
OWN=json.loads((ROOT/'.local/postgres/ownership.json').read_text());assert OWN['root'].rstrip('/')==str(ROOT) and OWN['port']==55495
COMMANDS=OUT/'commands.jsonl'
def run(label,args,cwd=ROOT,env=None,expected=0):
 log=OUT/(label+'.log');start=time.monotonic(); e=ENV.copy();e.update(env or {})
 with log.open('wb') as f:r=subprocess.run(args,cwd=cwd,env=e,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 entry=dict(label=label,args=args,cwd=str(cwd),exitCode=r.returncode,expected=expected,seconds=round(time.monotonic()-start,3),log=log.name,sha256=hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),bytes=log.stat().st_size)
 with COMMANDS.open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(entry)+'\n')
 print(json.dumps(entry),flush=True)
 if r.returncode!=expected:raise RuntimeError('Unexpected command outcome: '+label)
 return entry

def newdb(label):
 import uuid
 name='[OWN_DATABASE_REDACTED]'+label+'_'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
 e=ENV.copy();e['PGPASSWORD']=urllib.parse.unquote(URL.password or '')
 r=subprocess.run(['psql','-h','127.0.0.1','-p','55495','-U',urllib.parse.unquote(URL.username),'-d','postgres','-v','ON_ERROR_STOP=1','-c','CREATE DATABASE '+name],env=e,capture_output=True)
 if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError('Owned new database creation failed')
 with (OUT/'owned-databases.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps(dict(database=name,label=label,pgPort=55495))+'\n')
 return urllib.parse.urlunsplit(URL._replace(path='/'+name))
